messages:
maria: FYI — Peregrine SI just hit a blocker in the integration runbook. Need a quick sync on governance items before we hand this to Field Eng.
kevin: on it. what's the blocker?
maria: SI's validation test failed on our marketplace artifact signing step. Install succeeds but verification fails with "signature: policy-mismatch". They attached logs.
tara: this is the new marketplace signing flow we shipped last quarter? pinging @deploy-bot for the exact policy version.
deploy-bot: Automated notice: marketplace-signing-policy v2.1 deployed 2025-11-13. Current signing backend: cosign v1.13, keystore: k8s://projects/redwood/sign-key.
samir: I can repro locally — error comes from older cosign key formats. SI used legacy keys. We either accept a temp compatibility allowance or get them to re-sign with our current key binding.
kevin: re-sign sounds cleaner. If we re-sign their artifact on our side that affects governance/legal for the joint announcement — @olivia any constraints?
olivia: legal: we can approve a patch-level re-sign if the SI provides the artifact digest and a written attestation. Need change notice and a copy to legal.
maria: SI prefers a fast path: request us to allowlist their current signature so they can go live. Not great security-wise.
tara: prefer not to add allowlists. I'll share a tiny helper script they can run to re-sign with our approved flags instead.

```bash
# helper: re-sign Peregrine artifact with Redwood key
# Usage: ./resign.sh sha256:<digest>
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/sign-key --annotations "redwood:approved" sha256:<digest>
```

samir: that should work. I'll validate the new signature and run the integration test suite once they publish. I'll also add a short Console metric for signature-failure counts so we catch regressions.
kevin: please also update the runbook step 3/8 to include the exact cosign flags and a troubleshooting note. I'll take ownership of the runbook commit.
maria: action items: tara to share script + amended runbook, olivia to draft the legal approval note, samir to validate re-signed artifact, kevin to coordinate customer comms and update runbook. Target: next business day cutoff.
samir: I can turn around validation in <4 hours after they publish.
maria: customer also asked about doing a canary on Dedicated capacity before full cutover. @kevin — can we provision a 2-slot canary with reserved policy?
kevin: yes but needs infra capacity request. I'll open a capacity ticket and tag eng-infra. ETA ~6 hours if no blockers.
maria: perfect. I'll update Peregrine and loop in the SI PM. If anyone sees risk with the re-sign flow speak now. :thumbsup: 
olivia: legal has no objection to the re-sign workaround as long as we get the digest + attestation and CC legal on the change notice.
maria: pinging SI PM (external) to confirm re-sign timeline.
anna (Peregrine SI): We'll re-sign today and post the new digest in this thread. Thanks for the script.
kevin: I'll push the runbook diff to the partnership repo and tag v1.0.1.
maria: closing for now — we'll reconvene if validation fails. Thanks all.
